name: assignin
summary: Sets a variable in the caller's or the base workspace.
alternative: Return the value as an output, or keep named values in a struct.

name: audioread
summary: Reads an audio file.
alternative: No audio files.

name: categorical
summary: An array of values from a finite set of categories.
alternative: A cell array of character vectors with unique: [cats, ~, idx] = unique(labels) gives the categories and each element's index.

name: compose
summary: Formatted text for each element or row of an array, as a string array.
alternative: sprintf for one text, or arrayfun(@(x) sprintf(formatSpec, x), A, 'UniformOutput', false) for one per element.

name: containers.Map
summary: A map from character or numeric keys to values.
alternative: A struct with dynamic field names: s.(key) = value, isfield(s, key), fieldnames(s); keys must be valid field names.

name: csvread
summary: Reads a comma-separated file of numbers into a matrix.
alternative: load('data.csv') reads a comma-separated numeric file.

name: csvwrite
summary: Writes a matrix to a comma-separated file.
alternative: fopen and fprintf: fprintf(f, '%g,%g\n', M.').

name: cumtrapz
summary: The cumulative integral of sampled data by the trapezoidal rule.
alternative: [0, cumsum(diff(x) .* (y(1:end-1) + y(2:end)) / 2)] for row vectors; trapz for the whole integral.

name: datenum
summary: A date as a serial day number.
alternative: No serial dates; clock gives the current date and time as a vector.

name: datestr
summary: A date number or vector as text.
alternative: sprintf of clock's fields: c = clock; sprintf('%04d-%02d-%02d', c(1), c(2), c(3)).

name: datetime
signature:
t = datetime('now')
t = datetime(Y, M, D)
summary: Dates and times as an array type, with arithmetic, formats and time zones.
alternative: clock gives the date and time as [year month day hour minute seconds]; tic and toc time an interval.

name: digraph
summary: A directed graph object, with nodes, weighted edges and graph algorithms.
alternative: No directed graphs in any mode's graph library. In MATLAB mode, an adjacency matrix with loops: shortest paths by Dijkstra's algorithm (nonnegative weights) or Floyd's (no negative cycles), in a few lines.

name: dlmread
summary: Reads a delimited file of numbers into a matrix.
alternative: load reads whitespace- or comma-separated numeric files.

name: duration
summary: Lengths of time as an array type.
alternative: Plain numbers of seconds (tic and toc give seconds).

name: eval
summary: Runs MATLAB code given as text.
alternative: Function handles and feval (feval('cos', 0)), str2func for a function named by text, and struct fields (s.(name)) for values named by text.

name: evalin
summary: Runs text as code in the caller's or the base workspace.
alternative: Pass values as arguments and return them as outputs.

name: extractAfter
summary: The text after a pattern or position.
alternative: k = strfind(str, pat); str(k(1)+numel(pat):end) for a character vector.

name: extractBefore
summary: The text before a pattern or position.
alternative: k = strfind(str, pat); str(1:k(1)-1) for a character vector.

name: fillmissing
summary: Fills missing values (NaN) by a method such as a constant, the previous value or interpolation.
alternative: isnan with indexing: A(isnan(A)) = v for a constant; interp1 over the non-NaN points for interpolation.

name: fmincon
summary: Minimizes a function subject to constraints (Optimization Toolbox).
alternative: fminsearch for an unconstrained minimum, fminbnd for one variable on an interval, lsqnonneg for nonnegative least squares. General constraints have no solver in Sagebrush (a penalty term only approximates them, and can return an infeasible point).

name: fminunc
summary: Finds an unconstrained minimum by a gradient method (Optimization Toolbox).
alternative: fminsearch (Nelder-Mead, without gradients).

name: fscanf
summary: Reads formatted numbers from a text file.
alternative: load for a numeric file; fgetl with str2double(strsplit(line)) for others.

name: fsolve
summary: Solves a system of nonlinear equations (Optimization Toolbox).
alternative: fzero for one equation in one unknown; for a system, fminsearch on the sum of the squared residuals (a local minimum of 0 is a solution).

name: gpuArray
summary: An array stored on a GPU (Parallel Computing Toolbox).
alternative: Ordinary arrays: there is no GPU, and none is needed.

name: graph
summary: An undirected graph object, with nodes, weighted edges and graph algorithms.
alternative: Sage mode's Graph, for undirected graphs: shortest_path(u, v, by_weight=True), distance, connected_components, degree and adjacency_matrix (no minimum spanning tree there). In MATLAB mode, an adjacency matrix or an edge list with loops: for a minimum spanning tree, sortrows of the edges by weight and add each one that joins two components (Kruskal).

name: importdata
summary: Reads data from a file, guessing its format.
alternative: load reads a numeric text file, whitespace- or comma-separated (M = load('data.csv')); for other text, fopen with fgetl, strsplit and str2double; in Python mode, numpy.loadtxt.

name: imread
summary: Reads an image file into an array.
alternative: No image file reading.

name: imwrite
summary: Writes an array to an image file.
alternative: No image file writing; plots are saved as figures.

name: input
summary: Asks the user for a value at the command window.
alternative: No interactive input: set the value in the code, or pass it to a function.

name: inputParser
summary: An object that parses and validates a function's name-value arguments.
alternative: Check the arguments in code: nargin, isnumeric, ischar and error with a message; validatestring is not available either.

name: intlinprog
summary: Solves a mixed-integer linear program (Optimization Toolbox).
alternative: Sage mode's MixedIntegerLinearProgram.

name: ismissing
summary: Which elements are missing (NaN, NaT, empty text and so on).
alternative: isnan for numeric arrays; cellfun(@isempty, C) for cell arrays of text.

name: issorted
summary: Whether an array's elements are in sorted order.
alternative: all(diff(x) >= 0) for a numeric vector, or isequal(x, sort(x)).

name: jsondecode
summary: Parses JSON text into MATLAB values.
alternative: Python mode's json.loads.

name: jsonencode
summary: Encodes MATLAB values as JSON text.
alternative: Python mode's json.dumps.

name: linprog
summary: Solves a linear program (Optimization Toolbox).
alternative: Sage mode's MixedIntegerLinearProgram, which solves linear and mixed-integer programs.

name: lsqcurvefit
summary: Fits a nonlinear model to data by least squares (Optimization Toolbox).
alternative: polyfit for a polynomial; mldivide for a model linear in its parameters; fminsearch on the sum of squared residuals otherwise.

name: minspantree
summary: A minimum spanning tree of a graph.
alternative: No graph objects in MATLAB mode, and Sage mode's Graph has no minimum spanning tree: sortrows of the edge list [s t w] by weight, then add each edge that joins two components (Kruskal), tracking components in a vector.

name: normalize
summary: Data scaled to have mean 0 and standard deviation 1, or by another method.
alternative: (A - mean(A, 'omitnan')) ./ std(A, 'omitnan') for a vector, or the columns of a matrix: normalize computes the statistics without NaN elements, which stay NaN.

name: now
summary: The current date and time as a serial date number.
alternative: clock for the date and time as a vector; tic and toc for elapsed time.

name: ode15s
summary: Solves a stiff system of ordinary differential equations by an implicit method.
alternative: No implicit (stiff) solver in any mode: ode45 or ode23 handle mildly stiff problems with small steps.

name: ode23s
summary: Solves a stiff system of ordinary differential equations (Rosenbrock method).
alternative: No implicit (stiff) solver in any mode: ode45 or ode23 for mildly stiff problems.

name: parpool
summary: Starts a pool of parallel workers (Parallel Computing Toolbox).
alternative: Not needed: parfor runs as a for loop.

name: quadprog
summary: Solves a quadratic program (Optimization Toolbox).
alternative: Without constraints and with H positive definite (the problem then has a unique minimum), x = -H \ f. Constrained quadratic programs have no solver in Sagebrush; a penalty term with fminsearch only approximates them and can return an infeasible point.

name: rats
summary: Numbers as text in the form of ratios of integers.
alternative: [N, D] = rat(X), then sprintf('%d/%d', N, D) for each element.

name: readcell
summary: Reads a file into a cell array, one cell per field.
alternative: fopen and fgetl line by line, with strsplit for the fields.

name: readmatrix
summary: Reads a numeric matrix from a delimited text or spreadsheet file.
alternative: load reads a numeric text file, whitespace- or comma-separated (M = load('data.csv')); for other text, fopen with fgetl, strsplit and str2double; in Python mode, numpy.loadtxt.

name: readtable
summary: Reads a delimited text or spreadsheet file into a table.
alternative: load reads a numeric text file, whitespace- or comma-separated (M = load('data.csv')); for other text, fopen with fgetl, strsplit and str2double; in Python mode, numpy.loadtxt.

name: rescale
summary: Data scaled linearly to the interval [0, 1], or another interval.
alternative: (A - min(A(:))) ./ (max(A(:)) - min(A(:))) for an array that isn't constant (rescale scales by the extrema of the whole array; for [1 10; 3 20] that is [0 9/19; 2/19 1]).

name: rmmissing
summary: Removes missing values (NaN), or rows containing them.
alternative: A(~isnan(A)) for a vector; A(~any(isnan(A), 2), :) for rows of a matrix.

name: shortestpath
summary: A shortest path between two nodes of a graph.
alternative: Sage mode's Graph(...).shortest_path(s, t, by_weight=True) for an undirected graph; in MATLAB mode, Dijkstra's algorithm on an adjacency matrix (nonnegative weights), taking the min over the unvisited nodes.

name: smoothdata
summary: Smooths noisy data by a moving average or another method.
alternative: movmean or movmedian with a window length: movmean(A, 5).

name: solve
summary: Solves equations symbolically (Symbolic Math Toolbox).
alternative: Sage mode's solve. Numerically in MATLAB mode: roots for a polynomial, fzero for one equation in one unknown, mldivide for a linear system.

name: sscanf
summary: Reads formatted numbers from text.
alternative: str2double(strsplit(str)) for numbers separated by spaces or another delimiter; regexp with 'tokens' for other layouts.

name: strtok
summary: Splits text at the first delimiter into a token and the rest.
alternative: strsplit, or regexp(str, '^\s*(\S+)(.*)$', 'tokens', 'once'); for one delimiter, k = strfind(str, d) and indexing.

name: sym
summary: A symbolic variable or number (Symbolic Math Toolbox).
alternative: Sage mode for symbolic and exact rational work: x = var('x'); solve(x^2 - 2 == 0, x); QQ(1/4) + QQ(2/5). In MATLAB mode, [N, D] = rat(X) gives a rational approximation of X as N./D (exact for ratios of small integers); roots for polynomials and fzero for one equation.

name: syms
summary: Creates symbolic variables (Symbolic Math Toolbox).
alternative: Sage mode: var('x y').

name: table
summary: A table: columns of possibly different types with names, rows indexed by number or name.
alternative: A struct of equal-length column vectors (s.x, s.y), or a struct array with one element per row; sortrows and unique work on numeric matrices.

name: textread
summary: Reads formatted data from a text file (older function).
alternative: load reads a numeric text file, whitespace- or comma-separated (M = load('data.csv')); for other text, fopen with fgetl, strsplit and str2double; in Python mode, numpy.loadtxt.

name: textscan
summary: Reads formatted fields from a text file or string into a cell array.
alternative: fgetl line by line with strsplit and str2double, or regexp with 'tokens'.

name: typecast
summary: Reinterprets the bytes of numeric data as another type.
alternative: No byte reinterpretation in Sagebrush.

name: validateattributes
summary: Checks that an array has a given class and attributes, erroring otherwise.
alternative: isa, size, isreal and the is* functions, with error and a message.

name: webread
summary: Reads content from a web service.
alternative: No web access from MATLAB mode.

name: writematrix
summary: Writes a matrix to a delimited text or spreadsheet file.
alternative: fopen and fprintf, one format per row: fprintf(f, '%g,%g\n', M.').

name: writetable
summary: Writes a table to a delimited text or spreadsheet file.
alternative: fopen and fprintf: f = fopen('out.csv', 'w'); fprintf(f, '%g,%g\n', M.'); fclose(f).

name: xlsread
summary: Reads a spreadsheet file.
alternative: No spreadsheet files: save the sheet as CSV and read it with load (numbers) or fopen and fgetl (text).
